A '''Nerrian piper''' was a [[Musician/Legends|musician]]<ref name="TCWnovel" /> who hailed from<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Nerrian [[Musician/Legends|piper]]|system=[[Nerria system/Legends|Nerria system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Nerria system/Legends|Nerria system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> they were employed in the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|court]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] at his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TCWnovel" /> in the Outer Rim's [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nerrian piper appeared in [[Karen Traviss]]'<ref name="TCWnovel" /> [[July 26]], [[2008]]<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of<ref name="TCWnovel" /> the [[August 15]], 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|film]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].<ref name="YearByYear" /> In the book, by the time when the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TCWnovel" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrives in the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] room of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's palace during his and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|mission]] to return Jabba's kidnapped [[Gender/Legends|son]] [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]&mdash;who intends to drive a [[Clone Wars/Legends|wedge]] between Jabba and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;has made the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]] believe that Rotta has been [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by Skywalker, and the Nerrian piper is playing a [[Music/Legends|lament]] in the background of the room.<ref name="TCWnovel" />

[[File:Jabba_22BBY.png|thumb|right|250px|In the novelization of the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film, the Nerrian piper plays in the throne room of Jabba Desilijic Tiure (pictured).]]
After Skywalker looks at Rotta's empty crib and at the musician and then asks about the whereabouts of both Tano&mdash;who has been entrusted with carrying the kidnapped [[Youngling/Legends|infant]]&mdash;and Jabba's son, the piper stops playing in midrefrain shortly before Jabba delivers a furious response to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Ultimately, after Tano brings Rotta to the throne room and Jabba is reunited with the child, the Nerrian piper attempts, albeit with some difficulty, to switch to playing a happier melody amid a general sense of relief among the crime lord's court.<ref name="TCWnovel" /> The corresponding scenes in the film do not include any depiction of the musician.<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
